goal: Student learning progression in backend/routers/progress.py and frontend/src/app/dai-noi/hoc-tap/.
summary: Implemented authoritative student learning progression in backend/routers/progress.py, backend/services/progress_service.py, backend/apischemas/progress.py, and frontend/src/app/dai-noi/hoc-tap/page.tsx. Strictly tracks genuine server-acknowledged actions through the discrete 4-stage funnel: hidden -> discovered -> learned -> mastered. Enforces anti-replay gamification with cumulative XP caps (25 XP for discovery, 50 XP for lesson completion, 75 XP for quiz mastery, max 150 XP per motif). Prohibits negative abuse: simply clicking a 3D hotspot or client event cannot grant mastery XP or mastered status; quiz completion with score >= 80% is mandatory. Implements sliding-window rate limiting (30 actions/min) returning HTTP 429, idempotency caching, guest access restriction, and comprehensive interactive pedagogical visualization.

invariants_enforced.progression_funnel_integrity: Strict state machine progression: hidden -> discovered -> learned -> mastered. State transitions are verified server-side and cannot be bypassed or skipped.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_hotspot_guard: Hotspot 3D clicks or client-side events can ONLY transition from hidden to discovered (+25 XP). They CANNOT transition to learned or mastered, and client-claimed status parameters are strictly ignored.
invariants_enforced.lesson_mastery_boundary: Verified lesson completion transitions to learned (+50 XP, total 75 XP). It CANNOT grant mastered status.
invariants_enforced.quiz_pass_threshold: Mastery status and mastery bonus (+75 XP, total 150 XP) are strictly conditional on passing a server-evaluated quiz with score >= 80% (QUIZ_PASS_PERCENT). Scores < 80% record attempts but retain current status with 0 mastery XP.
invariants_enforced.anti_replay_gamification: Zero duplicate XP for already discovered, learned, or mastered relics. Idempotency key deduplication returns cached responses without re-executing mutations.
invariants_enforced.rate_limiting_protection: Sliding-window in-memory rate limiting (30 requests per 60 seconds per student) protects against bot spam, returning HTTP 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with Retry-After.
invariants_enforced.guest_access_guard: Guest users can only progress demo relics (is_demo=True); access to non-demo relics is rejected with HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN_GUEST_ACCESS.
invariants_enforced.multi_tenant_student_isolation: A student's progression on a relic is strictly isolated; progress earned by Student A does not leak to Student B.

changes.description: Added StudentProgressionRules, MotifProgressionItem, StudentProgressionSummaryOut, ProgressionActionRequest, and ProgressionActionResponse schemas.

Created progress_service module with ProgressionRateLimiter, idempotency cache, record_discovery, record_lesson_completion, record_quiz_completion, process_progression_action, get_student_progression_summary, and get_motif_progression_detail.

Created progress API router with endpoints: GET /api/v1/progress/summary, GET /api/v1/progress/motifs/{motif_id}, POST /api/v1/progress/action, POST /api/v1/progress/discover, POST /api/v1/progress/complete-lesson, and POST /api/v1/progress/submit-quiz.
Registered progress_router with the FastAPI application.

Added Tab 'Tiến trình năng lực & Chống gian lận' with 4-stage progression stepper, anti-abuse rule explanation cards, and an interactive simulation sandbox testing server validation, anti-replay, and rate-limiting responses.
Created comprehensive test suite with 10 integration test cases covering progression lifecycle, anti-replay, negative abuse guards, rate limiting, and multi-student data isolation.

test_details.name: test_progression_state_machine_happy_path
test_details.description: Verifies complete 4-step discrete lifecycle: hidden -> discovered (+25 XP) -> learned (+50 XP) -> mastered (+75 XP).

test_details.name: test_anti_replay_gamification
test_details.description: Verifies that duplicate discovery, lesson, and quiz calls award 0 duplicate XP, and idempotency key caching prevents re-execution.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_hotspot_cannot_grant_mastery
test_details.description: Verifies that 3D hotspot click cannot grant mastery XP or mastered status even when malicious client claims mastered in payload.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_failing_quiz_cannot_grant_mastery
test_details.description: Verifies that submitting a quiz with score < 80% (50%) records attempt but retains status and awards 0 mastery XP.

test_details.name: test_guest_and_validation_guardrails
test_details.description: Verifies guest role cannot access non-demo motifs (403), negative time spent is rejected (400), and non-existent motifs 404.

test_details.name: test_rate_limiting_enforcement
test_details.description: Verifies that sliding-window rate limit triggers HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with standard error envelope upon burst.

test_details.name: test_progression_summary_and_stats
test_details.description: Verifies progression summary aggregates counts across relics and returns completion/mastery percentages.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_lesson_cannot_grant_mastery
test_details.description: Verifies that completing a lesson transitions only to learned and awards max 75 cumulative XP, never granting mastered status.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_unanswered_quiz
test_details.description: Verifies submitting empty answers to quiz results in 0% score, retaining status with 0 XP awarded.

test_details.name: test_cross_student_progression_isolation
test_details.description: Verifies that Student A reaching mastered status on a motif leaves Student B's progress as hidden with 0 XP.
